subject.title: fix: recover updater from late launchd bootout errors

question: Should the focused stop-proof fix land from this PR before the overlapping wrapper-plist PR is rebased, or should both changes be consolidated into one branch?
rationale: Both open PRs edit the same updater stop/retry state machine with materially different retry filters and timing, so integration ordering requires an explicit owner decision to avoid duplicated or regressed behavior.

options.title: Land focused stop proof first
options.body: Merge this narrower implementation, then rebase the sibling PR and remove its duplicated retry code while preserving the independent plist repair.

options.title: Consolidate into sibling PR
options.body: Port this PR's error filtering and native-proof requirements into the sibling branch and close this PR only after the consolidated branch is verified.

options.title: Pause for live macOS proof
options.body: Hold both branches until a redacted launchctl, listener, and post-restart transcript demonstrates the combined exact-head behavior.

recommendation.title: Land focused stop proof first
recommendation.body: Merge this narrower implementation, then rebase the sibling PR and remove its duplicated retry code while preserving the independent plist repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The same person introduced and currently owns the affected updater state machine and authored both overlapping branches.
